ProductTargeting.description:
Spec ``Object: ProductTargeting`` — dimensional targeting/metrics.

All-lowercase wire names per the normative table; the six starred
attributes are required.

datasource.description: Data source that defines the target vocabulary (third-party schemas welcome by design).
datasource.title: Datasource

default.description: Default targetvalue(s) when the buyer selects none.
default.title: Default

name.description: What is described: Inventory, Delivery, Distribution, Investment, or Prohibitions.

selectable.description: Whether a buyer may select from targetvalues or the values are fixed.
selectable.title: Selectable

targetvalues.description: One or more values for the target (strings on the wire).
targetvalues.title: Targetvalues

type.description: How it is quantified: Frames, Audience, Investment, or Total.

ProductTargeting.title: ProductTargeting

TargetingUnit.description: Spec ``ProductTargeting.type``: how the entry is quantified.
TargetingUnit.title: TargetingUnit

description:
Spec REQUEST body for ``POST /products/avails``.

The published multi-product form: ``productids`` is an array, and
``accountid``/``advertiserbrandid`` are required. Use
:meth:`to_simplified` to bridge to the legacy single-product queries
(one per product id), recovering any minted Investment extension
entries (requested volume / budget) and the Segment-array targeting.

accountid.description: Account identifying the buyer, advertiser, and other stakeholders (spec-required).
accountid.title: Accountid

availabilityfields.description: ProductTargeting metrics availability is returned as.
availabilityfields.title: Availabilityfields

enddate.description: Desired delivery end (ISO-8601); must be after startdate.
enddate.title: Enddate

grouping.description: ProductTargeting metrics the availability output is grouped by.
grouping.title: Grouping

productids.description: Products to get availability + pricing for (spec-required, non-empty).
productids.title: Productids

producttargeting.description: ProductTargeting entries to target for the availability request.
producttargeting.title: Producttargeting

title: ProductAvailsSearch
